extraction.name: HELVIPAD
extraction.description: HELVIPAD is a real-world dataset for omnidirectional stereo depth estimation, featuring 40K video frames from video sequences across diverse environments, including crowded indoor and outdoor scenes with various lighting conditions.
extraction.creator: Mehdi Zayene, Jannik Endres, Albias Havolli, Charles Corbière, Salim Cherkaoui, Alexandre Kontouli, Alexandre Alahi
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected using a custom-built rig equipped with two omnidirectional cameras and a synchronized LiDAR sensor to capture video sequences in various indoor and outdoor environments.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Missing depth values were handled using a depth completion algorithm that interpolates the missing values and removes out-of-distribution samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Video sequences of dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes, synchronized with LiDAR point clouds.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automated generation of depth and disparity labels by projecting LiDAR 3D point clouds onto equirectangular images, followed by a depth completion pipeline to increase label density.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Alignment accuracy was assessed by calculating pixel error between LiDAR points and image positions. The depth completion pipeline was validated by splitting point clouds into training and test sets to compute depth estimation metrics.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LiDAR-to-Image Mapping Optimization algorithm and a fully automated depth completion pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset contains an imbalance in scene types, with certain situations like outdoor scenes at night being underrepresented compared to daytime outdoor and indoor scenes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The temporal aggregation approach used for depth completion is limited when capturing fast-moving objects, and occlusions are not explicitly handled during LiDAR-to-image mapping.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for training, validation, testing, and benchmarking omnidirectional stereo depth estimation models.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Depth completion via interpolation on spherical grid points using temporally aggregated point clouds to fill sparse depth labels.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Photometric data augmentation and depth completion to increase label density for the augmented training set.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering query points based on uncertainty and out-of-distribution thresholds, and cropping unnecessary regions such as sky and ground.
